entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle tier and largest, most densely populated borough of New Capenna, the city's cultural heart, between Park Heights and the Caldaia.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper tier of New Capenna, a ritzy playground above the Mezzio.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The lower tier of New Capenna, the fire of industry below the Mezzio.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A crime family headquartered in the Mezzio at the Vantoleone, led by Jetmir.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A crime family of mystics with a primary home in the Mezzio.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A crime family with enforcers on the Mezzio's streets.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A crime family of solicitors headquartered at the Central District Nido Sanctuary, led by Falco Spara.

entities.name: Central District Nido Sanctuary
entities.description: Headquarters of the Brokers, a clean office complex in the heart of the Mezzio.

entities.name: Vantoleone
entities.description: Headquarters and primary cabaret of the Cabaretti, a never-ending leisure and entertainment complex.

entities.name: Angel's Breath
entities.description: A small Cabaretti bar on the lower west side of the Mezzio.

entities.name: Bassomer Bridge
entities.description: A bridge connecting the Caldaia to the Mezzio.

entities.name: Cloudponte Bridge
entities.description: A bridge with a train station between Upper Bassomer Station and Crossponte Bridge.

entities.name: Kallock Library
entities.description: An Obscura location in the Mezzio.

entities.name: Mezzio Cleaners
entities.description: A launderer with six sections, one for each family and one for the public.

entities.name: Vesti Square
entities.description: A plaza in the never-dark center of the city.

events.summary: The Vanto Beatdown first began at the Vantoleone as an improvised dance-battle.
